item.text:
**2B.2 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the strongest 2024 evidence points to **yes** on proxy-war expansion and justification. I found clear public support for strikes on Israel and explicit calls for allies to intensify anti-Israel struggle. I also found one real restraint signal in April, when Tehran muted its response to the Isfahan incident. I found **no reliable 2024 evidence** of annexation or covert destabilization beyond the proxy-conflict / cross-border coercion pattern.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and indicated it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said the posture appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest 2024 de-escalation signal. | `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, said it demonstrated Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This directly justifies offensive action and frames it as useful leverage rather than restraint. | `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | In his first Friday sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei called on regional allies to “double your efforts and capabilities” and intensify resistance against Israel. This is direct evidence of prolonging and expanding proxy conflict. | `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `1B.6`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | The same April 21 statement also frames the strike as legitimate punishment for Israeli crimes. That is justification, not merely defense. | `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei also said each strike against Israel was a service to the region and to humanity, broadening justification for ongoing regional conflict. | `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** one meaningful de-escalation episode in April, when Tehran did not retaliate after the Isfahan incident.
- **Negative evidence:** Khamenei publicly celebrated the April strike on Israel and later urged allies to escalate the fight.
- **Net reading for 2024:** **yes**, he did justify and prolong proxy conflict beyond defensive necessity, even though there was at least one tactical restraint episode.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence of annexation or covert destabilization in the territorial sense.
- I also did **not** find a clean primary-source example of Khamenei personally initiating a new war of conquest; the record is instead centered on **proxy conflict, cross-border coercion, and rhetorical justification of strikes**.
